item.title: Daily News for Thursday, October 1, 2026
item.description: Today's throughline is AI narrative control. The industry — with Washington's backing — is actively rebranding itself as "superintelligence" to outrun public backlash, and that messaging fight is exactly the terrain your practice sits on: how institutions and brands talk about AI...
